concepts.name: Driver
concepts.definition: A person who competes in Formula 1 races, identified by full name (forename + surname) or driverRef.

concepts.name: Constructor
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 team or manufacturer that builds and enters cars.

concepts.name: Race
concepts.definition: A single Formula 1 event held at a circuit on a specific date.

concepts.name: Circuit
concepts.definition: A physical racing venue with geographic coordinates (lat, lng).

concepts.name: RaceResult
concepts.definition: The outcome of a driver in a specific race, including finishing position, points, time, and fastest lap data.

concepts.name: DriverStanding
concepts.definition: Cumulative championship standings for a driver after a given race.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per driver per race

concepts.name: ConstructorStanding
concepts.definition: Cumulative championship standings for a constructor after a given race.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per constructor per race

concepts.name: ConstructorResult
concepts.definition: Points and status earned by a constructor in a specific race.

concepts.name: Qualifying
concepts.definition: Qualifying session results for a driver in a race, split into Q1, Q2, Q3 segments.

concepts.name: PitStop
concepts.definition: A pit stop event during a race, with duration and lap information.

concepts.name: LapTime
concepts.definition: Time recorded for a specific lap by a driver in a race.

concepts.name: Status
concepts.definition: The reason or condition for a driver's race outcome (e.g., finished, accident, mechanical failure).

concepts.name: Season
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 season identified by year.

caveats.statement: Some race results have NULL time values, indicating the driver did not finish the race.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE time IS NULL;

caveats.statement: The status table uses statusId to represent different outcomes; statusId = 3 specifically means 'Accident'.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT statusId, status FROM status WHERE statusId = 3;

caveats.statement: Driver full names are split across forename and surname columns, so queries must concatenate them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT CONCAT(forename, ' ', surname) AS full_name FROM drivers LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: Qualifying times (q1, q2, q3) may be NULL for drivers who did not participate in that session.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying WHERE q1 IS NULL OR q2 IS NULL OR q3 IS NULL;

caveats.statement: The fastest lap speed column may contain NULL values for races where no fastest lap was recorded.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE fastestLapSpeed IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Pit stop duration is stored as a string and may need conversion for calculations.
Race names may have slight variations or typos (e.g., 'AustChineseralian Grand Prix'), so exact matching may fail.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM races WHERE name LIKE '%Grand Prix%' LIMIT 10;

evidence.result: [["Australian Grand Prix"], ["Malaysian Grand Prix"], ["Chinese Grand Prix"]]

caveats.statement: The earliest recorded year and month may not correspond to the first race in the dataset due to data ordering.
Constructor nationality is stored in the constructors table, not directly linked to results.
